chain.prompt: A polished Thoughtloom desktop application screen, edge to edge at 1536 × 1024, crisp readable text, no browser or device frame. Moment three of the same evolving inquiry, not a new app or option. Match the references’ header, source band, thinking surface and bottom composer; references carry visual grammar, not content to duplicate. Retain flat Night #031315 and Parchment #FEF6E1, Lantern #EFB83F main action, restrained Horizon #5E8BD6 selection, and Source Sans 3 for every heading, quote and control. The original-source band still quotes ‘Maybe AI agents should be allowed to disagree before committing to a design.’ Label ‘Original input · Unchanged’ and Open source. The inquiry trail now links Original thought → Your challenge → Emerging idea; these are recoverable positions, not mandatory wizard stages. The central working formulation is ‘Preserve intent across agent handoffs’, visibly ‘Developing idea · Tentative’ and ‘Proposed in this discussion’. Its brief body: ‘A handoff should preserve purpose, constraints, and decision ownership—not only instructions.’ An inspectable derivation directly beneath shows the original disagreement thought, the user’s challenge ‘The real issue isn’t orchestration; it’s preserving intent across context boundaries’, and the AI offshoot ‘What needs to survive a handoff?’ Attribute each; link to Open source or Open discussion. Keep unresolved lines visible: ‘Who decides whether intent survived?’ and ‘When is disagreement worth the delay?’ An inspectable ‘Depends on · Decision ownership’ remains an AI connection hypothesis. The composer invites ‘Keep exploring what must survive a handoff…’; principal Continue exploring, secondary Keep as developing idea. Explain ‘Separate from the original note; not applied to your history’. No saved-success claim, folders, all-notes sidebar, chronological chat river, giant graph, gradients, shadows, glow, serif, logo, fabricated dates or confidence scores. Footer: ‘Illustrative notes · New formulations remain open to challenge’.

chain.prompt: Edit this unapproved third Thoughtloom screen only to clarify attribution. Preserve the exact desktop composition, typography, header, original-source band, all quoted source/user words, derivation connections, open questions, composer and actions. In the central developing-idea box change the secondary line ‘Proposed in this discussion’ to ‘AI-proposed in this discussion’; retain ‘Developing idea · Tentative’. In the ‘Original thought · Unchanged’ evidence box, the quotation remains the user's exact original. Its separate sentence ‘Disagreement may expose assumptions before a decision’ is an AI interpretation, not part of the original: explicitly prefix that sentence ‘AI reading:’. In the ‘Your challenge · From this discussion’ box, preserve the user's challenge verbatim and explicitly prefix the separate explanatory sentence ‘AI reading:’. Do not silently attribute either interpretation to the user. Retain Open source/Open discussion, ‘AI offshoot’, ‘AI question · Open’, ‘AI connection hypothesis’, the illustrative-notes footer and ‘Separate from the original note; not applied to your history’. Match the existing Night/Parchment and restrained Lantern/Horizon grammar, flat surfaces and Source Sans 3-style sans. No new content, fabricated dates, saved-success claim, logos, sidebar, new panels, gradients, shadows, devices or browser frame. Keep 1536 × 1024. This is a single source-attribution correction, not a redesign.

brand.adaptation: Night/Parchment framing, purposeful Lantern/Horizon and Source Sans 3-inspired task type; no logo/emblem/artwork/font copied. Generated pixels approximate the reference.
